WITH nationality_totals AS (
  SELECT c.nationality,
         SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
         COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS result_records
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr
    ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT nationality,
       total_points,
       result_records,
       result_records - AVG(result_records) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM nationality_totals;
